Sleeping? Um, no, not really. I sleep fine, I guess. 

I mean, my mattress is terrible, but I still sleep. I got it from this guy on Craigslist when I first got my apartment, and he promised it was basically brand new, but there's this huge dip right in the middle. People in this town tailgate like crazy.

They got one of the nurses I work with last week, and she was so mad she complained about it for our entire shift. She wouldn't stop talking about how the radar gun must have been broken and how she was going to fight the ticket in court. She even printed out all these satellite maps of the road to prove the speed limit sign was obscured by a tree branch. She left the papers sitting on the break room table for days, right next to that disgusting microwave. 

But, um... yeah. Sleep is fine. I don't have trouble falling asleep or anything.

Energy? Um... no, not really. Even if I have a day off or sleep in late, my body just feels completely worn out. By the time I finish rooming patients and catching up on all the charts at work, I have absolutely nothing left in the tank. Appetite? Um, no, not really. I mean, I eat about the same, I guess. Nothing's really changed there.
